gloss: luggage tag; baggage label; shipping tag

definitions.gloss: luggage tag; baggage label; shipping tag
definitions.explanation: A tag or label attached to luggage, packages, or cargo indicating the destination, contents, or owner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{荷札|にふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I attached a tag to the luggage.

examples.japanese: {荷札|にふだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{宛先|あてさき}→宛先：12275_atesaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write the destination on the shipping tag.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引越|ひっこ}し→引越し：03704_hikkoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{荷札|にふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{運|はこ}び⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Putting tags on your moving boxes makes it easy to tell where they should go.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{荷|に}→荷：28294_ni⟧ (cargo, load) + ⟦{札|ふだ}→札：23002_fuda⟧ (tag, label). Used for any kind of label attached to packages, luggage, or shipped goods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荷札|にふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ — to attach a tag
- {荷札|にふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ — to write a tag
- {荷札|にふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧ — to remove a tag

- ⟦ラベル→ラベル：00348_raberu⟧ — label (loanword)
- ⟦{名札|なふだ}→名札：12338_nafuda⟧ — name tag
